title: Dream cycle inside reflect(): probe → diagnose → repair
change: Extend reflect() with an optional pass that generates synthetic task contexts, runs project(), scores the projections with the existing eval metrics, and proposes bounded relation edits for weak projections.
benefit: Finds weak projections before an Agent hits them; keeps repairs explainable because edits are typed relation changes.
risk: Semantic drift of typed relations; repairs must be reversible (soft decay, no deletes).
label: EXPERIMENTAL

title: Write-validation gate for LLM-authored cards and relations
change: Insert a validation step between ConceptExtractor output and the managers: duplicate signature check, relation-type check, contradiction check against existing relations; rejected writes are logged, not dropped silently.
benefit: Protects concept integrity (engineering priority 1) as the world grows from LLM writes.
risk: Over-strict gates could block legitimate concept evolution; needs a tunable threshold.
label: SUPPORTED

title: Projection-feedback relation weighting
change: Feed projection outcomes (used / unused / contradicted in the downstream task) back into relation weights with bounded updates, alongside the existing co-occurrence Hebbian updates.
benefit: Relation weights reflect operational usefulness, not only co-occurrence.
risk: Feedback loops can entrench early relations; needs decay and stability tests.
label: SPECULATIVE
